package: @astryxdesign/cli

## Install once, use everywhere

Install the CLI once for your computer too, and the astryx command works in any folder, for you and for any coding agent, even before a project exists. Inside a project, the project's own version still answers, so a global install never changes what your team and CI get. Keep it in the project as well; that is the recommended setup.

Terminal:
```bash
npm install -g @astryxdesign/cli
```

Project, global, or both: `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs global/project-global-or-both`. Everything else about global mode: `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs global`.

Up: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs getting-started --index
Previous: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs getting-started upgrade
Next: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs getting-started add-base-css-and-a-theme
